overview.startsWhen: A stakeholder reviews the platform scope and operating flow.
overview.userAction: Start the guided walkthrough or jump into any module from the side navigation.
overview.systemAction: Surfaces the core workflow, phase scope, sample data, API endpoints, and remaining inputs.
overview.businessResult: The full platform scope is visible before implementation begins.

auth.startsWhen: A new employee, manager, store keeper, or accounts user needs portal access.
auth.userAction: Admin creates the account, assigns one role, and the user completes secure first login.
auth.systemAction: Applies RBAC, token/session rules, lockout, first-login password change, and audit logging.
auth.businessResult: Access is controlled by role. Historical records are preserved when employees change.

dashboard.owner: General Manager, Operation Manager, Project Manager
dashboard.startsWhen: Management needs a company-wide operations view.
dashboard.userAction: Filter active projects, delayed reports, approvals, documents, stock, and alerts.
dashboard.systemAction: Refreshes role-scoped operational summaries every few minutes.
dashboard.businessResult: Management sees pending approvals, late reports, low stock, and document status in one view.

projects.startsWhen: A project is created or progress needs to be reviewed.
projects.userAction: Enter BOQ, milestones, phases, activities, team members, deadlines, and progress updates.
projects.systemAction: Calculates progress from approved quantities, discipline progress, WIRs, and timeline status.
projects.businessResult: Project tracking follows a consistent structure across all company projects.

reports.startsWhen: Daily site work is ready to be recorded.
reports.userAction: Supervisor saves field inputs; engineer verifies, adds official report details, and submits.
reports.systemAction: Validates mandatory fields, attaches photos/docs, numbers the report, and routes approval.
reports.businessResult: The daily report is a structured operational record with photo evidence and audit trail.

approvals.startsWhen: A report, document, material request, invoice, payment, or scope change needs sign-off.
approvals.userAction: Approve, reject with reason, delegate, or escalate according to role and SLA.
approvals.systemAction: Assigns approvers automatically, sends reminders, locks approved records, and audits overrides.
approvals.businessResult: Approval decisions are tracked with timestamps, reasons, and full audit history.

materials.owner: Store Keeper / Project Manager / Operation Manager
materials.startsWhen: Materials or tagged tools are requested, reserved, issued, transferred, returned, or consumed.
materials.userAction: Create issue/transfer requests, review warehouse/site stock, locate tagged tools, and record approved movements.
materials.systemAction: Prevents negative stock, reserves approved quantities, updates current location, flags low stock by location, and preserves movement history.
materials.businessResult: Inventory movement is traceable from supplier or warehouse to project site use.

documents.startsWhen: A MAR, MIR, WIR, drawing, delivery note, BOQ, contract, or invoice is uploaded.
documents.userAction: Upload metadata, route approval, preview active documents, and review version history.
documents.systemAction: Maintains revisions, superseded warnings, search, expiry reminders, and active-version control.
documents.businessResult: Field teams see the approved active version. Managers retain complete history and approvals.

photos.startsWhen: Photo evidence is attached to daily work.
photos.userAction: Capture up to five report photos or attach approved evidence from the gallery.
photos.systemAction: Stores original, display image, thumbnail, watermark, metadata, and recoverable deletes.
photos.businessResult: Photos are linked to reports, searchable, and access-controlled.

accounts.startsWhen: Costs, invoices, payments, salaries, and project budgets need review.
accounts.userAction: Enter invoices, validate costs, track status, and prepare payment approvals.
accounts.systemAction: Connects financial documents to projects, approvals, manpower, material cost, and P&L views.
accounts.businessResult: Project-level cost exposure is visible alongside field activity and approvals.

notifications.startsWhen: A pending action, rejection, approval, low stock item, or late report occurs.
notifications.userAction: Open alerts, act on assigned work, mute non-critical items, and review history.
notifications.systemAction: Sends in-app/email notifications, tracks unread counts, and keeps audit records separately.
notifications.businessResult: Workflows move forward through automated notifications and reminders.

admin.startsWhen: Users, permissions, overrides, or audit inspection are needed.
admin.userAction: Create/deactivate users, review logs, delegate unavailable approvers, and record override reasons.
admin.systemAction: Preserves old identities, blocks edits to approved reports, and records sensitive actions.
admin.businessResult: Governance controls are built in: identity preservation, override logging, and queryable audit trails.

mobile.startsWhen: A site user works on a phone or low-bandwidth network.
mobile.userAction: Save drafts, upload photos, view documents, and approve from a compact field flow.
mobile.systemAction: Autosaves, queues uploads, syncs when online, and keeps reference screens usable.
mobile.businessResult: The portal works on construction sites with compact mobile forms and offline support.

security.startsWhen: The portal handles reports, documents, finance, and employee data.
security.userAction: Configure retention, blocked file types, recovery windows, backups, and download controls.
security.systemAction: Uses audit logs, expiring URLs, encrypted backups, lockout, and role-scoped access.
security.businessResult: Access control, audit logging, and backup encryption are active from the first release.

delivery.startsWhen: The build scope and deployment plan are under review.
delivery.userAction: Confirm MVP scope, source data, hosting owner, acceptance scenarios, and migration inputs.
delivery.systemAction: Guides staging, production approval, backups, restore testing, browser/device QA, and launch import.
delivery.businessResult: The delivery scope maps directly to the implementation work breakdown.
